10.evidenceText: Multiple retail prices found: ebike24.com €4.90/€5.99; bike24.com €13.86/€12.93/€5.03; bike-discount.de €11.99/€9.99/€3.79/€9.99. Median of all 9 prices: €5.99
10.extractionRationale: Extracted median price from all retail prices found across 3 German retailers. Prices range from €3.79 to €13.86, representing various Clik Valve products (retrofit kits, conversion kits, inner tubes). The median of 9 distinct prices is €5.99, which appears as both a regular price at ebike24.com and represents the middle value of the price distribution.

30.evidenceText: Three product listings analyzed: no stock status information (out of stock, unavailable, nicht verfügbar, ausverkauft) found in the provided content snippets from any of the three sources.
30.extractionRationale: Stock status cannot be determined from the provided text evidence. The product pages show headers, ratings, and pricing information but do not include explicit stock status indicators in the extracted content.
